symptom: The research-only mapper relied on mutable Array.prototype.some/map to validate and retain parsed decision reasons, and map/sort to assemble reconciled records and their digest. Synthetic no-op helpers can erase valid reasons, miss malformed reason entries, or report PASS with mappedUnique zero and an empty records digest despite valid source rows. Node 22.16.0 source-equivalent reproduction confirmed a two-entry Map collapses to zero ordered records. No private data or production systems were involved.
lesson: Even when record validation and hashing use own-descriptor canonicalization, an upstream reconciliation mapper can silently discard accepted records or reasons through mutable ambient array helpers. A PASS status without preserved membership and stable ordered digest is not a trustworthy research audit.
guardrail: Parse JSON reason arrays with indexed own-descriptor checks and appendOwn; assemble reconciled records in deterministic recordId order using own-property writes, then compute digests with indexed iteration. Regression-test no-op Array.prototype.some/map/sort, reversed row order, malformed reasons and valid digest parity. This remains research-only and does not authenticate external source evidence or authorize promotion.
